opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Fast tech into Engineering Bay for early defense or upgrades, followed by bio production.
supporting_facts: The opening has a 100% rate of first_tech_observed, compared to a baseline of 6.3%, indicating a very early technology structure.
The opening has a 95.6% rate of has_ebay, compared to a baseline of 6.0%, showing an unusually early Engineering Bay.
The medoid key sequence is 'Prod_Barracks > Gas > Tech_EngineeringBay > Gas2 > Combat_bio', indicating a barracks-first build into an early Engineering Bay and then bio.
